Residential design and build

Prestige House: nine new apartments, Catford SE6

Catford, Lewisham, London2020 to 202216 photos

Comprehensive demolition and redevelopment of a former gas reduction facility, transforming the site from a single national utility structure into Prestige House, a collection of nine high-specification apartments (five one-bedroom and four two-bedroom) in Catford, South London. The scheme combined part demolition and conversion of the original building with a new three-storey L-shaped block, including piled foundations, and was completed and signed off by building control in May 2022 with a 10-year structural warranty.
